newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares ease in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares ease in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares eased slightly in light trade on Friday, dealers said.
The group A index fell by 53.63 points to 2,645 in quiet central market trade of just over one million litas.
There were no significant blue chip price movements and banking shares, which usually account for the lion's share of the bourse's activity, remained in the doldrums, turning over only 41,000 litas.
Dealers say that investors are waiting for year-end company results and are exercising caution after last month's bull run which pushed the infant bourse to new heights.
There has also been some concern among foreign investors about the stability of the national currency, the litas.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was 3.1 million litas and almost 320,000 litas worth of bloc trades were made on Friday.
